applicabilityBasis.summary: USDe issuer Ethena BVI limits direct redemption to approved Mint Users. Terms section 2 promises the pro rata reserve value in supported digital assets, capped at 1 USD notional per USDe and subject to fees and law; Holding Users have no direct redemption right. Section 23 separately refers to an eligible Mint User's right to redeem for USD. GENIUS section 2(22) requires a fixed monetary-value repayment obligation and separately excludes deposits and securities. These contractual provisions do not settle USDe's U.S. legal category. Applicability remains unclear pending qualified token-specific analysis of the holder contract and any exclusion; reserve eligibility and issuer authorization remain separate questions.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Ethena BVI Limited remains the USDe issuer; direct minting and redemption are restricted to eligible Mint Users and U.S. persons are excluded from those services. The contractual ambiguity described in applicabilityBasis remains unresolved. The reserve dashboard and the August 2026 report page disclose recurring custodian asset attestations; monthlyAttestationPresent records their public presence, not consolidated assets-and-liabilities assurance or statutory GENIUS compliance. Anchorage's USDtb issuance and announced PPSI intent concern a separate token and legal issuer. No token-specific USDe authorization or active U.S. GENIUS enforcement action was located in the public sources and name searches checked on this date; nonpublic filings and actions cannot be excluded. Treasury describes January 18, 2027 as the expected Act effective date and July 18, 2028 as the general DASP offer-sale restriction date. Its September 30, 2026 SCRC rule establishes interim state-certification procedures and does not establish USDe authorization or general Act effectiveness. Foreign-exception eligibility remains unknown, rather than inferred from the issuer's domicile.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, filed application or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for Ethena BVI Limited or USDe in the sources and public name searches checked. Anchorage documents identify USDtb as its Ethena-branded token; those materials do not authorize USDe. No active U.S. GENIUS action naming USDe was located. This is a dated and limited public-evidence finding, not an exhaustive certification of all filings or regulatory activity.
